module.label: Image -> Image
module.description: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo image edit. Install one Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo diffusion model, the Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder with its vision tower and the Qwen Image 2.1 VAE, then upload one to three reference images and describe the change. The older qwen_image_vae.safetensors is not compatible with Qwen Image 2.1.

groups.label: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo diffusion model
groups.why: Install one diffusion model. bf16 is the reference; int8_convrot is smaller and produces the same edit graph.

groups.label: Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder
groups.why: Qwen Image 2.1 needs the Qwen3-VL 8B encoder including its vision tower, because the references are encoded as image tokens. Install qwen3vl_8b_bf16 or qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot in models/text_encoders. A text-only GGUF lacks the vision tower and cannot edit reference images.

groups.label: Qwen Image 2.1 VAE
groups.why: The 2.1 VAE is required. The older qwen_image_vae.safetensors used by Qwen Image 1/Krea 2 is not compatible.

nodes.name: ComfyUI-GGUF
nodes.why: Only needed when the diffusion model or text encoder is a .gguf file. Safetensors installs do not need it.

models.label: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo (bf16)
models.name: qwen_image_2.1_turbo_bf16.safetensors
models.why: Reference bf16 diffusion model. Install one diffusion file.

models.label: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo (int8)
models.name: qwen_image_2.1_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors
models.why: Smaller int8 diffusion model. Install one diffusion file.

models.label: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo (GGUF Q8_0)
models.name: qwen-image-2.1-turbo-Q8_0.gguf
models.why: Optional GGUF diffusion model for ComfyUI-GGUF. Header reports architecture `qwen_image` and 265 diffusion tensors. Live-tested with a two-reference edit at 896x672.

models.label: Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (bf16)
models.name: qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors
models.why: Reference Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder. Install one encoder in models/text_encoders.

models.label: Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (int8)
models.name: qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors
models.why: Recommended Qwen3-VL 8B encoder. It ships the full vision tower, so ComfyUI can encode Image 1..n references. Install one encoder in models/text_encoders. Live-tested through CLIPLoader type `qwen_image`.

models.label: Qwen Image 2.1 VAE
models.name: qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors
models.why: Required Qwen Image 2.1 VAE. The old qwen_image_vae.safetensors is a different VAE. Live-tested decode at 896x672.
